UPDATE runs
        SET state = ?, quota_resets_at = NULL, quota_resume_owner_pid = ?,
            quota_resume_owner_started_at_unix = ?, quota_resume_claimed_at = ?, updated_at = ?
        WHERE id = ?
          AND state = ?
          AND quota_resets_at = ?
          AND quota_resets_at <= ?
          AND updated_at = ?
